h:
这是我用来生成角色的经过实战考验的 NoobAI/Illustrious 工作流程。它模仿 ADetailer 功能来放大生成的图像，并对角色的脸部和手部进行一些修复。

警告：由于 RvTools 的开发人员不支持 Nodes 2.0，因此应在 ComfyUI 常规设置中禁用它们。

工作流程所需的 ComfyUI 自定义节点：

  • ComfyUI 冲击包

  • rg三舒适

  • ComfyUI-易于使用

  • ComfyUI_essentials

  • ComfyUI-IcyHider

  • ComfyUI-RvTools_v2

  • ComfyUI-Lora-Manager

o.en:
This is the battle-tested NoobAI/Illustrious workflow I use to generate characters. It imitates the ADetailer feature to upscale the generated image and do some fix on character faces and hands.

Warning: since the developer of RvTools does not support Nodes 2.0 they should be disabled in ComfyUI general settings.

Required ComfyUI custom nodes for the workflow:

  • ComfyUI-Impact-Pack

  • rgthree-comfy

  • ComfyUI-Easy-Use

  • ComfyUI_essentials

  • ComfyUI-IcyHider

  • ComfyUI-RvTools_v2

  • ComfyUI-Lora-Manager
